audience: installers and service firms that quote, schedule and invoice jobs in Robaws

useCases.title: Check the open offers of a client
useCases.text: Search the client by name or VAT number. Then search that client's offers and open one to read its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Plan the work orders for a date range
useCases.text: Search work orders by date range, client or assigned employee. Open one to read its time, material and line entries.

useCases.title: Review recent sales invoices
useCases.text: Search sales invoices by text, date range or client. Open an invoice to read its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Find an article and its price
useCases.text: Search articles by name or article number. Open one to read its prices and calculation settings.

useCases.title: Add a new client or lead
useCases.text: Search first, because each create call makes a new record. Then create a client, or a lead when you set a lead status.

useCases.title: Confirm the connection and open a project
useCases.text: Check the connected Robaws user and its companies. Search projects by client, then open one.
